title: Mullet's NEW Big Block Will Turn the Earth Backwards!
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-37:13); second half (~16:09 onward) is an RC airplane segment with no car-build data

rule_change.fact: World Cup changed rules so Mullet's former radial class can now run a big tire if it meets the 'Warriors' rules, which makes the car heavy

tuner_builder.fact: Pete (shop name raw caption 'Harold Engine and Dyno') built the new engine and is the tuner

base_vehicle.note: model from caller context; chassis work at Cameron Johnson Race Cars

engine.block: tall-deck block (replaces standard-deck Brodix blocks; two standard-deck blocks were broken). Deck ~0.4 in taller
engine.heads: same heads as before, new valves: titanium intake, Inconel exhaust
engine.intake: same intake, new intake runners ('Steve's intake runners')
engine.rotating_assembly: R&R rods (caption 'R&R Hemi rods'), new Diamond pistons, new crank
engine.cam_sensor: Holley EFI cam sensor moved to cam drive (front); back of intake now fully sealed
engine.lubrication: converting to dry sump (oil tank size TBD, current tank very large)
engine.builder: Pete (raw caption 'Harold Engine and Dyno'; low confidence on name)

power_adder.notes: Cleetus unsure current turbos can reach the new engine's capability; previously 'ran as much boost as we wanted' but it broke things

power_claims.fact: New engine has close to 1,000 hp more capability (claimed)
During grudge banter one speaker says ~1,000 hp more, another says at least 800 more (speakers unclear)

ecu.notes: Holley EFI cam sensor implies Holley EFI (only sensor named)

tires.type: big tire (switched from radials); first big-tire outing was very successful before engine failure

exhaust.notes: Driver-side hot side (header to turbo) needs shortening + new V-band; charge pipes to be remade

passes.desc: First pass ever on big tires ran a 6.40-something (quarter mile implied)
Only two passes on big tires before engine failure

failures.cause: broken from being leaned on too hard (high boost)
chronic oil leak out the back of the intake after high-boost passes; smoke trail and oil under car
drops to single digits at big end when chutes deploy; motivation for dry sump

parts.part: Titanium intake valves / Inconel exhaust valves

targets.grudge: FL2K grudge vs Eagle to the 1,000 ft mark for $150 (negotiated from $7,500 class payout idea)

cars.confidence: high for engine change list; low for builder name spelling

cars.owner_driver: Cameron Johnson (brings it to FL2K); driver Troy Odell
cars.description: Street-legal-ish 'fully roadworthy' car per Cameron (banter); set up as quarter-mile car; Troy promotes no-time races in Florida
cars.notes: Race setup claimed to be quarter mile; no-time class pays $7,500 to win (stated)

cars.build_version: Pat Musi 903 ci nitrous big block swap

base_vehicle.chassis: carbon tub; back half recently redone; front half being replaced with Menscer strut front end at CJ Racecars

engine.notes: described as a 3,500 hp nitrous motor (claimed); bought used from a buddy

history.fact: Raced the car for a buddy for a couple years, then bought it; hurt the old motor on last outing
Quote for a class-legal motor was about $38,000; declined

other_refs.fact: C7 ZR1 giveaway car ran a 9.1 quarter mile, still on drag radials, 5 in intake
ZR2 giveaway truck got polished Custom Offsets wheels with Ridge Grappler tires

game_use.engine_failure_model: standard-deck big block cracked under very high boost; tall deck as fix
